name: Data table
description: A table wired up with search, filters, sortable columns, row selection with bulk actions, column visibility and pagination.

props.name: columns
props.type: { id: string; header: string; cell?: (row) => ReactNode; value?: (row) => string | number | null; sortable?: boolean; align?: "start" | "end"; width?: number | string; isRowHeader?: boolean; hideable?: boolean; defaultHidden?: boolean }[]
props.description: The columns, in order. value is used for sorting, for search when searchKeys is left out, and as the cell when cell is left out. The row header column cannot be hidden.

props.name: rows
props.description: The rows. Each needs a stable id; see getRowId.

props.name: getRowId
props.description: Reads a row's id for selection.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Rows per page at first. People can change it below the table.

props.name: searchKeys
props.description: Fields the search box looks in, ignoring case and accents. Defaults to every column's value.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder and label for the search box. Defaults to "Search" and the plural noun.

props.name: filters
props.type: { id: string; label: string; allLabel?: string; value: (row) => string; options: { id: string; label: string; tone?: "neutral" | "brand" | "success" | "warning" | "destructive" }[] }[]
props.description: A select for each filter beside the search box. A tone adds a coloured dot to the option.

props.name: rowActions
props.type: { id: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; tone?: "default" | "destructive" }[]
props.description: Items in each row's menu. A destructive item gets a separator above it.

props.name: bulkActions
props.type: { id: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; tone?: "default" | "destructive" }[]
props.description: Buttons in the bar that appears above the table while rows are selected.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called with the action's id and the rows it applies to: one row from a row menu, or every selected row from the bar. The selection clears after a bulk action.

props.name: noun
props.description: Words for the count above the table, as in "48 customers" or "12 of 48 customers".

props.name: title
props.description: Replaces the count above the table.

props.name: description
props.description: A muted line under the count.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Other props go to the root element.
